config.description: Leads, requests, service and team workload

pages._note: Bespoke 360-degree client record (ClientDetail.vue): edit/new mode toggle plus a custom header and eleven CnDetailCard panels wired to klantbeeld-360 relations (contacts, deals, contactmomenten, invoices) and inline NcDialog editors; the standard 'detail' page type renders a single object's fields and cannot host this aggregated multi-relation layout.
pages.title: Client

pages._note: Bespoke contact record (ContactDetail.vue): edit/new mode with a custom header and CnDetailCard panels for linked client, contactmomenten and a CnFormDialog inline editor; the standard 'detail' type shows only one schema's fields and cannot express the cross-relation klantbeeld-360 layout.
pages.title: Contact

pages._note: LeadList.vue extends a CnIndexPage with lead-specific bulk controls (NcCheckboxRadioSwitch quick-filters plus CnMassImportDialog / CnMassExportDialog) that the declarative 'index' page type does not expose; kept as a host-app component until those bulk actions are promoted to the library.
pages.title: Leads

pages._note: ProductBarcodeSearch.vue is a single-purpose scanner surface: a barcode/EAN input that resolves one product and shows an NcEmptyContent fallback when nothing matches; it is neither a list nor an object-detail page, so no standard page type fits.
pages.title: Barcode lookup

pages._note: POS receipt ledger as a declarative type:index page (pipelinq-declarative-pages-round1). Row view + Add both navigate to the bespoke cart editor routes (PosTransactionDetail / PosTransactionNew), which stay custom because they host interactive line-item editing.
pages.title: Kassabon

pages._note: PosTransactionForm.vue is a bespoke cart/checkout form (line-item rows, NcSelect tender pickers, totals math) for ringing up a sale; the standard form/detail page types cannot host the interactive line-item editing the POS register requires.
pages.title: Nieuwe transactie

pages._note: Reuses PosTransactionForm.vue (the bespoke cart/checkout editor with line-item rows and tender pickers) in edit mode; no standard form/detail page type can host the interactive line-item editing.
pages.title: Transactie bewerken

pages._note: POS refund ledger as a declarative type:index page (pipelinq-declarative-pages-round1). Row view navigates to the bespoke refund editor (PosRefundDetail); Add navigates to PosRefundNew. Both editors stay custom (interactive per-line refund selection).
pages.title: Retouren

pages._note: Reuses PosRefundForm.vue (bespoke refund editor: per-line refund selection and tender NcSelect) pre-seeded from the originating transaction; the interactive line-selection logic has no standard form page-type equivalent.
pages.title: Nieuwe retour

pages._note: Reuses PosRefundForm.vue (bespoke refund editor with per-line refund selection and tender NcSelect) for a standalone refund; the interactive line-selection logic has no standard form page-type equivalent.
pages.title: Nieuwe retour

pages._note: Reuses PosRefundForm.vue (bespoke refund editor with per-line refund selection and tender NcSelect) in edit mode; the interactive line-selection logic has no standard form page-type equivalent.
pages.title: Retour bewerken

pages._note: PosRefundDetail.vue is a CnDetailPage composed with refund-specific CnDetailCard panels, a CnStatusBadge and refund-only actions; the declarative 'detail' type renders flat schema fields and cannot lay out these grouped refund cards.
pages.title: Retour

pages._note: CashShiftList.vue is a CnIndexPage specialised for the cash-drawer shift register (shift-specific columns/state on the cashShift schema); kept as a host-app component while those presets live outside the library.
pages.title: Kassalade

pages._note: CashShiftDetail.vue is a CnDetailPage with cash-drawer-specific CnDetailCard panels (opening/closing float, counted-vs-expected variance), CnStatusBadge and open/close actions; the standard 'detail' type cannot express this reconciliation layout.
pages.title: Shift

pages._note: Daily Z-report (end-of-day close) ledger as a declarative type:index page (pipelinq-views-to-declarative-r1). Row click navigates to the bespoke ZReportDetail (per-tender totals / tax breakdown / resubmit), which stays custom. No Add (Z-reports are generated by the day-close job, not created by hand).
pages.title: Boekhoudkundige Afhandeling

pages._note: ZReportDetail.vue is a CnDetailPage with Z-report-specific CnDetailCard panels (per-tender totals, tax breakdown, drawer reconciliation) and CnStatusBadge; the declarative 'detail' type cannot lay out these aggregated accounting summaries.
pages.title: Z-report

pages._note: PosCustomerSettings.vue is an in-app settings surface (NcSettingsSection with the POS customer-lookup configuration form); it edits app configuration rather than register objects, so no object-oriented page type applies.
pages.title: POS customer lookup

pages._note: BrpMonitor.vue is a bespoke operational monitor for BRP (Dutch persons-registry) connection health and recent lookups, with its own status/refresh layout; it is a live diagnostics panel, not a list or detail of register objects, so no standard page type fits.
pages.title: BRP Monitor

pages._note: KassakoppelingAuditList.vue is a bespoke audit-trail viewer for the kassakoppeling (cash-register fiscalisation link) with append-only entries and verification actions rendered in a custom layout; the generic 'index' type cannot express the immutable-audit presentation and per-row verify controls.
pages.title: Kassakoppeling audit

pages._note: KassakoppelingAuditDetail.vue is a CnDetailPage with audit-specific CnDetailCard panels showing the signed payload, hash chain and verification result of one fiscalisation entry; the standard 'detail' type cannot render this signed/verifiable audit layout.
pages.title: Audit entry

pages._note: PosTransactionDetail.vue is a CnDetailPage with five receipt-specific CnDetailCard panels (line items, tenders, taxes, customer, linked refunds), CnStatusBadge and nine contextual actions (refund, reprint, email); the flat 'detail' type cannot host this grouped receipt layout.
pages.title: Transactie

pages._note: PosRoleList.vue is a CnIndexPage specialised for POS role definitions (permission-summary columns on the posRole schema); kept as a host-app component while those POS-permission presets live outside the library.
pages.title: POS rollen

pages._note: Uses PosRoleForm.vue, a bespoke role editor with a grid of NcCheckboxRadioSwitch permission toggles; the per-capability toggle matrix has no standard form page-type representation.
pages.title: Nieuwe rol

pages._note: Reuses PosRoleForm.vue (bespoke role editor with a permission-toggle grid) in edit mode; the per-capability NcCheckboxRadioSwitch matrix has no standard form/detail page-type representation.
pages.title: POS rol

pages._note: PosStaffList.vue is a CnIndexPage specialised for POS staff accounts (role/PIN-status columns on the posStaff schema) with staff-only row actions; kept as a host-app component while those presets live outside the library.
pages.title: POS medewerkers

pages._note: Uses PosStaffForm.vue, a bespoke staff editor combining identity NcTextFields, a role NcSelect and a PIN/active NcCheckboxRadioSwitch; the mixed credential + role-assignment form has no standard form page-type representation.
pages.title: Nieuwe medewerker

pages._note: Reuses PosStaffForm.vue (bespoke staff editor: identity fields, role NcSelect, PIN/active toggles) in edit mode; the mixed credential + role-assignment form has no standard form/detail page-type representation.
pages.title: POS medewerker

pages._note: MyWork.vue is a personal cross-entity worklist: it merges tasks, deals and contactmomenten assigned to the current user into grouped, due-date-coloured sections with entity badges and quick-filter buttons; no single-register 'index' page can aggregate across these schemas.
pages.title: My Work

pages._note: RapportageView.vue is a bespoke analytics surface: a CnDashboardPage whose widget slots are filled with custom-computed report blocks fetched once and shared across slots, rather than the manifest-declared widget set the standard 'dashboard' type supports.
pages.title: Analytics

pages._note: RapportageDashboard.vue is a bespoke contact-reporting analytics view with a date-range selector, a custom KPI-card grid and hand-rendered channel bar charts; the standard 'dashboard' type only composes declared widgets and cannot host these custom-drawn charts.
pages.title: Contact reporting

pages._note: ChannelAnalytics.vue is a bespoke analytics report: a date-range selector over a custom comparison data-table of per-channel metrics with colour-keyed channel dots; this tabular cross-channel comparison has no standard list/dashboard page-type representation.
pages.title: Channel analytics

pages._note: AgentPerformance.vue is a bespoke analytics report: a date-range selector over a sortable per-agent data-table (resolution time, volume, satisfaction); the sortable multi-metric leaderboard has no standard list/dashboard page-type representation.
pages.title: Agent performance

pages._note: PipelineBoard.vue is a bespoke drag-and-drop kanban of deals across pipeline stages, with a pipeline selector, search and list/board view toggle; the standard 'index' type renders a flat table and cannot provide the stage-column drag interaction.
pages.title: Pipeline

pages._note: ExportJobs.vue is a CnIndexPage specialised for BI export jobs with run/schedule controls in the page header; kept as a host-app component while those export-trigger actions live outside the library.
pages.title: BI export jobs

pages._note: ExportJobForm.vue is a bespoke export-job builder (destination NcSelect, dataset/field selection and schedule NcTextFields rendered as a CnDetailPage); the multi-section job configuration has no standard form page-type representation.
pages.title: New export job

pages._note: Reuses ExportJobForm.vue (bespoke export-job builder with destination, dataset and schedule sections) in edit mode; the multi-section job configuration has no standard form/detail page-type representation.
pages.title: Export job

pages._note: ExportDestinations.vue is a CnIndexPage specialised for export destinations with a connection-test action in the header; kept as a host-app component while that test-connection action lives outside the library.
pages.title: Export destinations

pages._note: ExportDestinationForm.vue is a bespoke connection editor: transport NcSelect plus credential NcTextFields and an NcCheckboxRadioSwitch whose visible fields change per destination type; this conditional connection form has no standard form page-type representation.
pages.title: New export destination

pages._note: Reuses ExportDestinationForm.vue (bespoke connection editor with type-conditional credential fields) in edit mode; this conditional connection form has no standard form/detail page-type representation.
pages.title: Export destination

pages._note: ExportRuns.vue is a CnIndexPage specialised for the export run history with a re-run action in the header; kept as a host-app component while that re-run action lives outside the library.
pages.title: Export runs

pages._note: ExportRunDetail.vue is a CnDetailPage with run-specific CnDetailCard panels (row counts, duration, error log) and a CnStatusBadge; the flat 'detail' type cannot lay out these execution-result cards.
pages.title: Export run

pages._note: StufEndpoints.vue is an in-app settings surface (NcSettingsSection listing the configured StUF SOAP endpoints and their toggles); it edits app configuration rather than register objects, so no object-oriented page type applies.
pages.title: StUF endpoints

pages._note: StufAuditLog.vue is a bespoke StUF message audit viewer inside an NcSettingsSection, with type/status NcSelect filters over the request/response envelope log; the message-envelope filtering and presentation has no standard list page-type equivalent.
pages.title: StUF audit log
